programme.title: Blackmail
programme.desc: Dev discovers that his wife, Reena, has been cheating on him with Ranjit. To teach them a lesson, he decides to blackmail the cheating duo as part of his revenge.

programme.title: Maati Maangey Khoon
programme.desc: Hariya is clueless about his parents and discovers that his family was destroyed by Thakur Balram Singh. He vows to take revenge, especially after his friend, who is Balram's nephew, also opposes him.

programme.title: Biwi.Com
programme.desc: When a pandit predicts that Kishan will marry thrice in his lifetime, his wife Shilpa forces him into a second marriage. When the wives start fighting, a third woman arrives from London for Kishan.

programme.title: Blood Relation
programme.desc: Full of action and drama.

programme.title: Blue Oranges
programme.desc: When a wealthy alcoholic turns up dead, Detective Nilesh investigates the murder by interrogating various suspects that include her former lover, a spoilt brat and the commissioner's brother.

programme.title: Kahani Kismat Ki
programme.desc: A reformed man tries to make an honest living for himself and his family after his jail term. His life takes an ugly turn when a woman claims him to be her husband and he is also framed for murder.

programme.title: Kundan
programme.desc: Shamsher Singh, who is involved in criminal activities, decides to get the better of Kundan, a police officer, after realising that he is a threat to him.

programme.title: Nakshatra
programme.desc: Ajay works on a new script, which is based on a robbery of an expensive necklace, for some producers. However, things take a turn when the scene is enacted in real-life and the blame falls on Ajay.

programme.title: China Gate
programme.desc: Colonel Puri requests his former fellow army officers court-martialed in disgrace to redeem themselves by rescuing a village from Jageera, an evil bandit.

programme.title: Antardwand
programme.desc: Mani, a spoiled brat, is brought up in a caste-ridden society. When he is sent to his uncle's house for studies, he finds his life entangled in a situation of love, revenge and gratitude.

programme.title: Aar Ya Paar
programme.desc: Shekhar is having an affair with Anu, his wealthy wife's secretary. When the wife finds out, they kill her. The police then find evidence against him, and he learns that Anu is likely to betray him.

programme.title: Kehte Hain Muzko Raaja
programme.desc: Action Movie.

programme.title: Naya Din Nayi Raat
programme.desc: Sushma, a young girl, runs away from home to escape an arranged marriage. On her way, she meets many people, each representing a distinct facet of human nature, who help her in her difficulties.

programme.title: Daraar
programme.desc: Raj Malhotra, a wealthy man, falls in love with Priya Bhatia, a real estate agent, as soon as he meets her. When he proposes to her for marriage, he discovers that she is already married.

programme.title: Sultanat
programme.desc: Sultan, a brave warrior, tries to win the affections of Yasmin, a beautiful woman. However, his life turns upside-down when his father is killed by a general who he then swears revenge against.

programme.title: Shiva Shakti
programme.desc: Shiva forms a close friendship with Shakti when he comes to the city to earn money for his sister Kusum's wedding. However, he later vows to kill Shakti when Kusum becomes pregnant with his child.

programme.title: Gurudev
programme.desc: Inspector Dev Kumar has to choose between arresting his childhood friend Guru's father, who is a notorious criminal, and his integrity.

programme.title: Pyaar Ka Safar
programme.desc: Bharath has lost everything since his childhood including his love. He is supported by his childhood friend Bhargava. Does Bhargava help him or will he end up destroying him completely?

programme.title: Hiraasat
programme.desc: ACP Ashok Saxena is an honest middle-class police officer who lives with his wife, Shobha, and college-going brother, Rajesh. However, he is framed in a case of drug-trafficking and gets arrested.

programme.title: Jagan
programme.desc: Jagan, an artist by profession, befriends two siblings on separate occasions and they both fall in love with him. He is forcibly married to the elder sister by goons, creating troubles in his life.

programme.title: Ajab Gazabb Love
programme.desc: Rajveer, a rich man, falls in love with Madhuri. However, he soon realises that she detests affluent people and in order to win her heart, he, along with his family, pretends to be poor.

programme.title: Taqdeer Ka Tamasha
programme.desc: An officer shares a strained relationship with his brother Satya, a criminal. When he tries to collect evidence against a goon, he meets his sibling. But they are not aware of the gangster's secrets.

programme.title: Mr. Natwarlal
programme.desc: When Natwar's elder brother is framed for bribery, he decides to avenge his brother's humiliation and thus poses as a crime lord.

programme.title: Dhadkan
programme.desc: Anjali and Dev are in love with each other and plan to marry, but her family gets her married to Ram. Years later, Dev shows up to reunite with Anjali, however, she has fallen in love with Ram.

programme.title: Baadshah
programme.desc: Raj, a small-time private detective who is desperate for a big break, gets drawn into a political conspiracy when he is hired to rescue a hostage.

programme.title: Ram Balram
programme.desc: Jagatpal raises his nephews, Ram and Balram, after killing their parents. He hatches an evil plan to push Ram into the world of smuggling and earn money, but the brothers unite to take him down.

programme.title: Anari Ishq
programme.desc: Rama, a simpleton, is appointed as the bodyguard of Rajnandini, a rich girl. She soon falls in love with him but her brothers' violent nature gets in the way of her uniting with Rama.

programme.title: Zindagi Gulzar Hai
programme.desc: Kashaf, a young woman raised by a single mother, faces a lot of class and gender bias while growing up. However, her life turns around when she meets Zaroon in college.

programme.title: Teri Kasam
programme.desc: Dolly, a rich and spoilt woman, falls for Tony, a poor musician, and marries him. However, her arrogance begins to create problems in their marital life.

programme.title: Haisiyat
programme.desc: Union leader Ram is also married to his boss. When there is a conflict between the management and the workers, Ram must decide if his duty lies towards his wife or towards his union and the workers.

programme.title: 16 December
programme.desc: Four Indian Revenue Service officers are assigned to intercept and arrest a group of Pakistani terrorists. The terrorists plot to detonate a nuclear bomb in New Delhi and the IRS must stop them.

programme.title: Devta
programme.desc: Balram, a rogue, who works for crime lord Bajrang decides to kill inspector Rakesh for sending him to prison. However, he changes his mind when he learns a secret about Rakesh.

programme.title: Market Raja MBBS
programme.desc: While in the pursuit of Raja, a ruthless don, the police accidentally kill Chandrababu, a medical student. Things take a turn when Chandrababu's spirit possesses Raja and turns him into a gentle soul.

programme.title: Papi Gudia
programme.desc: A criminal uses a possessed doll to lure children and kill them. His latest target is Raju, the young brother of a dancer, who soon becomes the main suspect in a series of murders.

programme.title: Samay-when the time strikes
programme.desc: ACP Malvika Chauhan, a widowed mother, is assigned to investigate the murder of a businessman. However, she suspects it to be a serial killer as more murders take place in the city.

programme.title: Prithipal Singh...A Story
programme.desc: Disappointed with his Olympic bronze medal, Prithipal Singh quits hockey and joins a university. However, things get worse for him when he is accused of murdering a student.

programme.title: Jigri Dost
programme.desc: Shobha prepares to marry an advocate named Anand as arranged by her father. However, she secretly follows him one day and is shocked to see him in the arms of another woman.

programme.title: Agnivarsha
programme.desc: In a kingdom stricken with drought, two rival priests, Yavakri and Parvasu, try to appease the rain god, Indra. However, their efforts result in adultery, treachery and bloodshed.

programme.title: Meri Haan Teri Naa
programme.desc: Childhood friends Ashok and Julie are very close and believe friendship is above love. However, when Julie's father dies, Ashok and his wife bring her to their house and try to find a groom for her.

programme.title: Avinash
programme.desc: Avinash, a singer and a dealer of stolen goods, finds his life turned upside down when some goons break into his house and assault his fiancee.

programme.title: Juaari
programme.desc: Vijay, a young man, resorts to gambling in order to free his lover, Anita, who is held captive by Sanga. He soon runs out of luck when he gets arrested.

programme.title: Demon
programme.desc: Vignesh Shivan has scary dreams that bother him a lot. However, the strange things in his dreams make him worry and affect his mind.

programme.title: Race
programme.desc: Two stepbrothers own a huge stud farm and a horse racing business. When they learn that they have a common love interest, one of them tries to kill the other and inherit the insurance money.

programme.title: Ek Aur Prem Deewani
programme.desc: After falling in love with her music teacher, a princess wishes to break off her engagement with a US-based man. As a result, her wedding day turns out to be full of unexpected events.

programme.title: Kaali Topi Laal Roomaal
programme.desc: Commando Vijay arrests a terrorist, Master DD. However, he realises that Master DD is just a pawn and tries to find the real culprit.

programme.title: Kehte Hain Muzko Raaja
programme.desc: Action Movie.

programme.title: Mera Karam Mera Dharam
programme.desc: Ajay, a businessman, provides funds to Sarjuprasad to develop his hometown. When he learns that the money has been misappropriated by Sarjuprasad, he resolves to set things right.

programme.title: Wafadaar
programme.desc: Chanda's parents disapprove of her boyfriend Ranga and want her to marry Prasad. Ranga is accused of having an affair with Sita. Chanda faces turmoil in her life.

programme.title: Koyelaanchal

programme.title: Insaniyat

programme.title: Bumm Bumm Bole

programme.title: Dil Hai Tumhaara

programme.title: 1999 UCL Final v Bayern Munich
programme.desc: United Archives 26/5/99. An absolute classic, with two trophies in the bag only Bayern Munich stood between United and an unprecedented treble.

programme.title: PL: United v Liverpool 06/07
programme.desc: United Archives 22/10/06. Paul Scholes and Rio Ferdinand are both on the score sheet as United see off Rafa's Liverpool at Old Trafford.

programme.title: PL: Man City v United 12/13
programme.desc: United Archives 9/12/12. Relive this unforgettable Manchester derby as United travelled to the Etihad Stadium knowing victory would leave Sir Alex Ferguson's side in pole position in the title race.

programme.title: FAC: Wimbledon v United 93/94
programme.desc: United Archives 20/2/94. United make light work of Wimbledon in this fifth round FA Cup tie.

programme.title: FAC: v Oldham 93/94 SF Replay
programme.desc: United Archives 8/4/90. United take on Joe Royle's Oldham at Maine Road after a last minute Mark Hughes goal secured a replay three days prior at Wembley.

programme.title: FAC: United v Arsenal 07/08
programme.desc: United Archives 16/2/08. Sir Alex's 100th FA Cup game in charge of United saw them take on Arsenal, one of the oldest and fiercest foes.

programme.title: PL: United v Tottenham 08/09
programme.desc: United Archives 25/4/09. United took on Tottenham knowing that victory was a must, with Liverpool desperate for the Reds to slip up.

programme.title: 2008 UCL FInal: v Chelsea

programme.title: 1999 UCL Final v Bayern Munich
programme.desc: United Archives 26/5/99. An absolute classic, with two trophies in the bag only Bayern Munich stood between United and an unprecedented treble.

programme.title: PL: United v Portsmouth 07/08
programme.desc: United Archives 30/1/08. Cristiano Ronaldo scored arguably his greatest goal in a United shirt, as that unforgettable free kick helped the Reds claim a vital three points.

programme.title: PL: United v Newcastle 07/08
programme.desc: United Archives 12/1/08. An uneventful first half is quickly forgotten about when United put Newcastle to the sword in the final 45.

programme.title: The Undertaker
programme.desc: 2023. Thriller. Director: Michael Wright. Stars Paul McGann, Tara Fitzgerald & Murray Melvin. An undertaker makes the wrong call at a moral crossroad and has to dispose of a gangster's victims.

programme.title: Bad Blood
programme.desc: 1981. Drama. Directed by Mike Newell. Starring Jack Thompson. Set in WW2, a New Zealand farmer who refuses to hand in his firearms and the siege that follows. Based on a true story.

programme.title: The Disappearance of Flight 412
programme.desc: 1974. Sci-fi. Directed by Jud Taylor. Stars Glenn Ford & Bradford Dillman. When Flight 412 witnesses the disappearance of two fighter jets, a military group attempts to cover up the incident.

programme.title: What's On TPTV With Noel
programme.desc: Founder of Talking Pictures TV and one half of the Footage Detectives, Noel Cronin, shares shows and films not to be missed throughout November.

programme.title: Sergeant Cork
programme.desc: The Case of the Girl Upstairs. 1963. Stars John Barrie, William Gaunt & Mary Kenton. Cork and Marriott investigate the case of a terrified woman who is under the supervision of a sadistic doctor.

programme.title: Burke's Law
programme.desc: Who Killed Mother Goose? 1965. Stars Gene Barry, Gary Conway & Regis Toomey. A children's writer is found dead with typewriter ribbon the murder weapon. A secretary and a prodigal son are in the frame

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Fine Finny Fiends. 1966. Stars Adam West, Burgess Meredith & Bill Williams. The Penguin brainwashes Alfred and vacuums the Dynamic Duo to loot Bruce Wayne's multimillionaires' award dinner.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Batman Makes the Scenes. 1966. Stars Adam West, Bill Williams & Burgess Meredith. Batman tells Alfred the location of the multimillionaire's dinner, enabling the Penguin to execute his evil plan.

programme.title: Cinebox Memories
programme.desc: Pop singer Wayne Gibson performs the phenomenal hit I Like It.

programme.title: Algiers
programme.desc: 1938. Drama. Directed by John Cromwell. Stars Charles Boyer, Hedy Lamarr & Sigrid Gurie. A wanted jewel thief hiding in the Casbah meets a beautiful woman who makes him long for an escape.

programme.title: Mark of the Phoenix
programme.desc: 1957. Crime drama directed by Maclean Rogers and starring Anton Diffring. Crooks steal a secret metal formula and plan to smuggle it into East Germany.

programme.title: Railway Murders
programme.desc: The Police Killer. 2021. Stars Nicholas Day, Judith Rowbotham & Alan Moss. 37 year old Detective Sergeant Robert Kidd was murdered in September 1895. His life taken in the line of duty.

programme.title: Make Me An Offer
programme.desc: 1954. Comedy. Directed by Cyril Frankel. Starring Peter Finch. The story of Charlie, who as a boy fell in love with a Portland Vase on a trip to a museum, pursues his dream as an antiques dealer.

programme.title: Tell Me Another
programme.desc: More Stories about Their Careers. 1976. Personal anecdotes as told to Dick Hills. This episode stars Bernard Manning, Alfred Marks, Leslie Phillips, Marjorie Proops & Terry Scott.

programme.title: Dusty Ermine
programme.desc: 1936. Drama. Directed by Bernard Vorhaus. Starring Margaret Rutherford and Anthony Bushell. Going 'straight' after being in jail, Jim is suspected when forged notes start circulating in the area.

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: Tables Turned. 1956. Stars Richard Greene, Victor Woolf & Archie Duncan. Messengers are guarding the jewels, but loose talking allows Derwent to her about it; so, he plans to steal them!

programme.title: My Brother's Keeper
programme.desc: 1948. Thriller. Directed by Alfred Roome and starring Jack Warner, George Cole, David Tomlinson and Bill Owen. Two convicts escape, handcuffed to each other and things get worse when they're seen.

programme.title: The Cheaters
programme.desc: The Rocker. 1962. Stars John Ireland, Robert Ayres & Oliver Johnson. The story of how John Hunter became to work for Eastern Insurance is suspicious. Will Hunter have to prove his innocence?

programme.title: A Family At War
programme.desc: 1971. Into The Dark. Created by John Finch. Stars Colin Douglas & Shelagh Fraser. Philip is brought into a desert hospital blinded. John considers suicide and Margaret makes her choice. (S2, E14)

programme.title: The Young Mr. Pitt
programme.desc: 1942. Drama. Director: Carol Reed. Stars: Robert Donat, Robert Morley & Phyllis Calvert. This biopic tells the story of the 24-year-old British Prime Minister who served during the Napoleonic era.

programme.title: Public Eye
programme.desc: 1975. Detective & Mystery Drama. Nobody Wants to Know. Stars Alfred Burke, Ray Smith & Geoffrey Beevers. Marker has one week to find a witness. When he does so, he will never forget her.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Join Caroline Munro as she gives an insight into tonight's film the 1953 horror The Four Sided Triangle, a brilliant Hammer Film directed by Terence Fisher.

programme.title: The Four Sided Triangle
programme.desc: 1953. Sci-fi Romance. Directed by Terence Fisher. Stars Barbara Payton, James Hayter & Stephen Murray. A man duplicates a woman who fell in love with his friend, so he may have a copy for himself.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Caroline Munro takes a look at the special film to be shown next week down in The Cellar Club.

programme.title: Body Double
programme.desc: 1984. Thriller. Directed by Brian De Palma. Stars Craig Wasson & Melanie Griffith. A struggling actor's obsession with spying on a neighbour gets him caught up in a drastic series of events.

programme.title: Tomorrow
programme.desc: 1972. Drama. Directed by Joseph Anthony. Stars Robert Duvall, Olga Bellin & Sudie Bond. A lonely farmer takes in a pregnant drifter, but things take an unexpected turn after she gives birth.

programme.title: The Most Dangerous Game
programme.desc: 1932. Horror. Directors: Ernest B. Schoedsack & Irving Pichel. Stars Fay Wray, Joel McCrea, Leslie Banks & Robert Armstrong. Shipwrecked on an island, a hunter becomes the guest of Count Zaroff.

programme.title: Cinebox Memories
programme.desc: 1963. Join English pop group The Mudlarks as they perform the charming hit song La De Da.

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: Ring of Greed. 1955. Stars Megs Jenkins, Clifford Evans & Betty Anne Davis. Margaret and Frank fell in love at first sight but will Margaret manage to escape from a fate that is unknown to her?

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Shoot a Crooked Arrow. 1966. Stars Adam West, Art Carney & Doodles Weaver. Batman and Robin battle a latter-day Robin Hood who turns against the poor people of Gotham.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Walk the Straight and Narrow. 1966. Stars Adam West, Art Carney & Loren Ewing. Batman and Robin escape their previous peril and are back in action seeking to foil the Archer's devious plans.

programme.title: Minesweeper
programme.desc: 1943. War drama starring Richard Arlen, Jean Parker & Russell Hayden. A former naval deserter is drawn back to the services after the attack on Pearl Harbour.

programme.title: Talk About Jacqueline
programme.desc: 1942. Comedy. Director: Harold French & Paul L. Stein. Stars Hugh Williams & Carla Lehmann. A woman meets a researcher. When they marry, he runs across some scandalous gossip about her past.

programme.title: Radio London 1967
programme.desc: A short promo film shot on board the Radio London pirate radio ship in summer 1967, shortly before the station's closure. DJ's seen include John Peel, Mark Roman, Pete Drummond and Willie Walker.

programme.title: Legend of the Hidden City
programme.desc: 1997. Stars Brendan Pollecutt, Fezile Mpela & Robert Finlayson. Morgan plans to attack 'The Source'. Meanwhile, Ram declares war on Queen Kama and her people.

programme.title: William Tell
programme.desc: The Trap. 1959. Stars: Conrad Phillips, Willoughby Goddard & Jennifer Jayne. By using a traitor planted in Tell's camp, Gessler plans to smash the resistance movement in one swoop.

programme.title: Hawkeye & the Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: La Salle's Treasure. 1957. Directed by Sam Newfield. Stars John Hart, Lon Chaney Jr & Rodney Bunker. Fortune hunters seek a treasure rumored to have belonged to the French explorer La Salle.

programme.title: The Lone Ranger
programme.desc: Rustler's Hideout. 1949. Stars Jay Silverheels, Clayton Moore & John Hart. The Lone Ranger believes in Fred Vance and helps him settle during a war between the Madden gang and local ranches.

programme.title: Supercar
programme.desc: Hostage. 1961. Stars George Murcell & David Graham. While in Ireland, Dr. Beaker overhears a plan by two smugglers to kidnap the daughter of an innkeeper and alerts his friends back at base.

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: Food for Thought. 1957. Stars Richard Greene, John Sharplin & Patrick Troughton. A pair of villagers go to Robin's camp with news of an oppressive tax recently imposed by the greedy Count Olivier.

programme.title: Biggles: Adventures in Time
programme.desc: 1986. Sci-Fi. Director: John Hough. Stars Peter Cushing, Neil Dickson, Alex Hyde-White. The daring flying ace takes on his arch rival aided by a British intelligence officer and a time traveller.

programme.title: H.M.S Defiant
programme.desc: 1962. Drama. Director: Lewis Gilbert. Stars Alec Guinness, Dirk Bogarde & Maurice Denham. During the French Revolutionary War, Captain Crawford is stuck in a battle of with his second in command.

programme.title: Scales of Justice
programme.desc: 1965. Personal and Confidential. Stars Edgar Lustgarten & Ellen McIntosh. Police investigating a suspicious death find a file marked 'Top Secret' in the victim's briefcase. (S1, E07)

programme.title: The Quatermass Xperiment
programme.desc: 1955. Horror. Director: Val Guest. Stars Brian Donlevy, Jack Warner & Thora Hird. A manned rocket ship returns to Earth with two astronauts missing and the survivor incapable of communicating.

programme.title: Tell Me Another
programme.desc: How They Started in Showbusiness. 1976. Personal anecdotes as told to Dick Hills. This episode stars Yootha Joyce, Bernard Manning, Alfred Marks, Leslie Phillips, Terry Scott & Max Wall.

programme.title: Dick Turpin
programme.desc: The Godmother. 1982. Stars Richard O'Sullivan & Joan Sims. Glutton's Godmother, the Duchess of Durham comes to visit, and Sir John must convince her that he is married to become her heir.

programme.title: Maigret
programme.desc: The Golden Fleece. 1961. Stars Rupert Davies, Ewen Solon & Francis De Wolff. Maigret investigates a strange accident, noticing that the men of the Paris canals do not take well to interference.

programme.title: Lillie
programme.desc: The Jersey Lily. 1978. Stars Francesca Annis, Jennie Linden & Peter Egan. In London, Lillie becomes a 'Professional Beauty' and a social sensation. She also meets Oscar Wilde and Princess Louise.

programme.title: Prudence and the Pill
programme.desc: 1968. Comedy. Directed by Fielder Cook. Stars Deborah Kerr, David Niven & Judy Geeson. Five couples get involved in comical chaos when they swap birth control pills to deceive each other.

programme.title: EuroTrash
programme.desc: 1998. Hosted by Antoine de Caunes. Tonight, we meet The Belgian Baldmen, get squashed in a squash court, then go back to nature in Germany and meet the German Pamela Anderson.

programme.title: Around the World in 80 Raves
programme.desc: 2001. Stars Vernon Kay, Paul Eastwood & Glenn Ward. Following a group of young people around America as they go to various raves, nightclubs, events and other parties.

programme.title: Confessions of a Window Cleaner
programme.desc: 1974. Comedy. Directed by Val Guest. Stars Anthony Booth, Robin Askwith & Dandy Nichols. The adventures of an optimistic and inept window cleaner who finds other ways to satisfy his customers.

programme.title: Rentadick
programme.desc: 1972. Comedy. Director: Jim Clark. Stars James Booth, Richard Briers & Julie Ege. The incompetent detectives of Rentadick Inc track thieves of a nerve gas that paralyses from the waist down.

programme.title: The Girl On The Pier
programme.desc: 1953. Crime. Director: Lance Comfort. Stars Veronica Hurst, Ron Randell & Marjorie Rhodes. Rivalry between a Brighton crooner who has done time and his partner in crime, who is being blackmailed.

programme.title: One Step Beyond
programme.desc: Make Me Not a Witch. 1959. Stars Patty McCormack & Robert Emhardt. A girl's parents are terrified when their daughter reveals that she can read minds. But her gift may be able to save lives.

programme.title: Enter the Lone Ranger
programme.desc: 1949. Western. Directed by Geroge B. Seitz Jr. Stars Clayton Moore & Jay Silverheels. The sole surviving Texas Ranger of a murderous ambush becomes the great masked hero who fights for justice.

programme.title: What's On TPTV With Noel
programme.desc: Founder of Talking Pictures TV and one half of the Footage Detectives, Noel Cronin, shares shows and films not to be missed throughout November.

programme.title: The Super Secret Service
programme.desc: 1953. Comedy. Directed by Charles W. Green. Stars Peter Sellers, Graham Stark, Dick Emery & Raymond Francis. Brilliantly bizarre comedy short about the workings of the 'Super Secret Service'.

programme.title: Paratrooper
programme.desc: 1954. War. Director: Terence Young. Stars Leo Genn, Alan Ladd & Harry Andrews. Distraught over his role in a tragic training accident, a US Air Force officer secretly enlists in the British Army.

programme.title: Lest We Forget
programme.desc: An exclusive documentary commemorating the end of WWI. Presented by war historian Alan Forbes who visits the battlefields and memorials of Flanders and the Somme.

programme.title: We Will Remember Them
programme.desc: We join the nation in paying tribute to the fallen. We honour our heroes with The Last Post.

programme.title: Carve Her Name With Pride
programme.desc: 1958. War Drama. Director: Lewis Gilbert. Stars Virginia McKenna, Paul Scofield & Jack Warner. Based on the true story of WW2 special agent Violette Szabo recruited to work as a spy in France.

programme.title: Review No.1 29th Year (The Royal British Legion)
programme.desc: Take a look at what the Royal British Legion are doing to support their members and veterans of the British Armed Forces, also with a glimpse of the history of the charity.

programme.title: Nine Men
programme.desc: 1943. War. Director: Harry Watt. Stars Gordon Jackson, Jack Lambert & Frederick Piper. British soldiers are attacked when travelling across the desolate wastes of WWII Libya.

programme.title: That's My Boy
programme.desc: Hello Young Mothers. 1985. Stars Mollie Sugden, Janet Davies & Jenny Tomasin. Ida discovers that there are plans to open a home for unmarried mothers and Mrs. Cross starts a petition against it.

programme.title: For the Love of Ada
programme.desc: The Baby. Stars: Wilfred Pickles, Irene Handl & Jack Smethurst. As Ruth appears to be going into labour, Ada and Walter are troubled in their new home by the presence of a ghost. (S4, E01)

programme.title: The Man from U.N.C.L.E
programme.desc: The Deadly Goddess Affair. 1966. Stars Robert Vaughn, David McCallum & Michael Strong. Solo faces death and Illya faces possible matrimony as they try to steal significant funds from THRUSH.

programme.title: The Footage Detectives
programme.desc: Mike and Noel are joined by Isla St Clair where she shares footage and opens up about childhood memories and her career. And there's a reel from one of the first TV stations to transmit from home.

programme.title: Enemy At The Door
programme.desc: Jerry Bag. 1978. Stars: Alfred Burke, Bernard Horsfall & Emily Richard. On her father's death, Betty Ridge gets work as a cleaner for the Germans, meeting young soldier Erich.

programme.title: My Cousin Rachel (1952)
programme.desc: 1952. Mystery. Directed by Henry Koster. Stars Olivia de Havilland, Richard Burton & Audrey Dalton. The heir to a considerable fortune attempts to find out if the woman he loves is a murderess.

programme.title: Look At Life The Sky's The Limit
programme.desc: 1963. A look at the aerobatics of the RAF and the civil flyers.

programme.title: Fox
programme.desc: If It's Good Enough for New Orleans It's Good Enough for Clapham. 1980. Stars Larry Lamb & Bernard Hill. London turns out to say goodbye to Billy and his funeral is exactly as he would want it.

programme.title: The Runaway Train
programme.desc: 1985. Action. Directed by Andrey Konchalovskiy. Stars Jon Voight, Eric Roberts & Rebecca De Mornay. Two escaped convicts and a railway worker find themselves trapped on an out of control train.
